correctness.rationale: The published sharp normalized bounds are Fminus=exp(-t/n)*tanh(t/2)*(t/n)/sinh(t/n) and Fplus=exp(t/n)*coth(t/2)*(t/n)/sinh(t/n). Differentiating gives the submitted stationarity equations; the ratio minimizes exactly at asinh(n), while published theorem establishes uniqueness of the two other extrema. For t=log(2n)+δ with |δ|<=2log(2n)/n, t*csch(t)=(t/n)e^(-δ)+O(t/n³) and (t/n)coth(t/n)=1+t²/(3n²)+O(t⁴/n⁴), proving δ_A=−L/(3n)+O(L²/n²), δ_B=+L/(3n)+O(L²/n²). Second derivatives at these points are ∓1/n+O(L/n²), so quadratic relative regret is (1/(2n))(L/(3n))²=L²/(18n³). Independent bisection/numerical evaluation for n=20,100,1000,10000 shows scaled gaps approaching 1/3 and both scaled regrets approaching 1, without being used to prove asymptotics.
